trigger: Approach the Virginia Street bridge checkpoint.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Day nineteen. Ninety-one degrees and dust. The Virginia Street bridge is sandbags, a Humvee and one sunburned corporal.

nodes.speaker: cpl_haas
nodes.text: ID. Address. Is that a dog or a lawsuit?

nodes.speaker: cpl_haas
nodes.text: Huh. MWD? ...Washout? Yeah. She's got washout eyes. Like me. Okay.

nodes.speaker: cpl_haas
nodes.text: Pearce. Sparks. You carrying meds, fuel or firearms? I have to search for meds, fuel or firearms.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The clinic bag is in your pack. Lolo needs it back across this bridge tonight.

choices.text: It's for a home clinic. Lolo Arrieta.

nodes.speaker: cpl_haas
nodes.text: I'm gonna search this bag with my eyes closed. Wow. Nothing in here. Go.

nodes.speaker: cpl_haas
nodes.text: ...The Basque lady? She stitched my cousin's hand in '19. Fine. I didn't see a bag.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He takes the bag. He looks sorry about it. A little.

nodes.speaker: cpl_haas
nodes.text: Okay. Ration line's in the convention center. Bring something to sit on. It's three hours.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Across the river, the casinos are dark. Someone has spray-painted the arch: BIGGEST LITTLE BLACKOUT.
